decision: Allocate 50% discovery, 25% Trace sharing, 15% content and 10% HQ maintenance per work cycle.

scope: Connect existing internal schedules and preserve current authority
decision: Reuse the six existing desks for the HQ mandates and A–G handoff.
rationale: Original operations already have schedules, claims, reviews and cloud receipts. Connect the package and expose verified status rather than duplicate timers or tasks.
consequences: Existing schedule IDs, cadence, targets, models and notification settings preserved.
Charters v1.1 explicitly permit eligible bounded work through the existing desks.
Red actions and new cloud-worker deployment remain gated.

scope: Local durable HQ foundation and bounded runtime evaluation
decision: Extend existing Postgres with mandate-scoped jobs and reviewed memory; keep the current Operating Room authoritative and evaluate QM only as a replaceable worker backend.
rationale: Oday requested the Postgres extension and reference review. One shared database with enforced scopes preserves memory without a database per persona.
alternatives: Adopt a second complete agent platform now
Create separate memory databases for every agent
consequences: Local implementation and fictional verification only; production migration and cloud worker are not authorized by this record.
HQ retains canonical memory review; current room tasks are not dispatched twice.
Discovery and accepted repeated work justify future automation.
review_trigger: Internal identity integration and first proposed worker cutover

scope: Bounded HQ preview worker pilot only
decision: Approve up to $20/month additional pilot spend: $10 Railway, $8 OpenAI API, $2 contingency.
rationale: Prove one supervised cloud job before broader desktop migration.
consequences: One bounded cloud run completed; independent output review and recurring activation remain open.
No external sends, publication, production release or customer import is authorized.
review_trigger: Pricing revalidation by 1 October 2026, exhausted budget or material scope change

scope: Exact first internal cloud draft and bounded daily check
decision: Approve the one-time additional specialist-review exception and daily cloud check for new approved snapshots.
rationale: Specialist output Auditor reached the Codex usage limit; Supervisor independently checked source fidelity.
alternatives: Keep paused until specialist capacity returns
consequences: First draft accepted internally; no canonical promotion.
Daily check enabled; unchanged snapshot produces no model call.
